name: Orosil Smiths India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Orosil Smiths India Ltd is in the business of gems & jewellery, and textiles.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
OSIL is engaged in the 
manufacturing, fabrication,
 sale, purchase, trading, and 
dealing of:
a) Gold
b) Silver
c) Silver ornaments 
and utensils
d) All other items related
 to gold, silver, and allied 
businesses
